default.$description:
White page background. Pair with base/default, 
sunken/default and raised/default.

inverse.$description:
Near-white tinted page background. Pair with base/inverse, 
sunken/inverse and raised/inverse.

brand.$description:
Red page background for brand-immersive layouts. Pair with 
base/brand, sunken/brand and raised/brand.

brand-muted.$description:
Soft red-tinted page background. Pair with base/brand-muted, 
sunken/brand-muted and raised/brand-muted.

midnight.$description:
Deep dark page background. Pair with base/midnight, 
sunken/midnight and raised/midnight.

default.$description:
Primary content section on canvas/default. Grey offset 
provides contrast against the white canvas.

inverse.$description:
Primary content section on canvas/inverse. White surface 
contrasts against the tinted canvas.

brand.$description:
Primary content section on canvas/brand. Deeper red 
contrasts against the brand canvas.

brand-muted.$description:
Primary content section on canvas/brand-muted. Stronger 
red tint contrasts against the muted canvas.

midnight.$description:
Primary content section on canvas/midnight. Dark surface 
sits within the deep midnight canvas.

default.$description:
Secondary content area on base/default — tabs, locked states, 
secondary description blocks. Darker grey recedes below 
the base/default surface.

inverse.$description:
Secondary content area on base/inverse. Slight tint recedes 
below the base/inverse surface.

brand.$description:
Secondary content area on base/brand. Deeper red recedes 
below the base/brand surface.

brand-muted.$description:
Secondary content area on base/brand-muted. Stronger red 
tint recedes below the base/brand-muted surface.

midnight.$description:
Secondary content area on base/midnight. Deeper dark tone 
recedes below the base/midnight surface.

default.$description:
Accent container on base/default — cards, highlighted items, 
focal content. White surface lifts above the grey base.

inverse.$description:
Accent container on base/inverse. White surface lifts above 
the inverse base.

brand.$description:
Accent container on base/brand. Lighter red lifts above 
the deeper brand base.

brand-muted.$description:
Accent container on base/brand-muted. Near-white tint lifts 
above the muted brand base.

midnight.$description:
Accent container on base/midnight. Mid-dark surface lifts 
above the deep midnight base. Cross-variant use intentional 
for extra accent when design requires it.

scrim.$description:
Semi-transparent backdrop behind modals and drawers. 
Dims the content below to focus attention on the 
overlaying element.

floating.$description:
Background for elements floating above the surface 
hierarchy — tooltips, dropdowns, popovers. Sits outside 
the canvas/base/sunken/raised stacking system.

floating-middleground.$description:
Background for elements floating above the surface 
hierarchy — tooltips, dropdowns, popovers. Sits outside 
the canvas/base/sunken/raised stacking system.

floating-inverse.$description:
Dark variant of floating surface — tooltips, dropdowns, 
popovers on light backgrounds where dark treatment 
is preferred.

lg.$description:
Strong dark tint for decorative glass elements. 
Use on light surfaces where high opacity contrast 
is required.

md.$description:
Medium dark tint for decorative glass elements. 
Balanced transparency for most glass use cases 
on light surfaces.

sm.$description:
Subtle dark tint for decorative glass elements. 
Barely-there overlay for light surfaces where 
minimal contrast is needed.

xl.$description:
Strong light tint for decorative glass elements. 
Use on dark surfaces where high opacity contrast 
is required.

lg.$description:
Medium light tint for decorative glass elements. 
Balanced transparency for most glass use cases 
on dark surfaces.

md.$description:
Subtle light tint for decorative glass elements. 
Barely-there overlay for dark surfaces where 
minimal contrast is needed.

sm.$description:
Subtle light tint for decorative glass elements. 
Barely-there overlay for dark surfaces where 
minimal contrast is needed.

default.$description: Primary text on light surfaces. Use for headings, titles, and body copy

subtle.$description: Secondary text on light surfaces. Use for captions, helper text, and supporting copy

muted.$description: Tertiary text on light surfaces. Use for placeholders, timestamps, and the lowest-emphasis readable content.

disabled.$description: Disabled state for default text. Remains legible but signals an inactive element.

inverse.$description: Primary text on dark surfaces. Pair with canvas/midnight or base/midnight.

inverse-subtle.$description: Secondary text on dark surfaces. Use for captions and supporting copy over midnight.

inverse-muted.$description: Tertiary text on dark surfaces. Lowest readable emphasis over midnight.

inverse-disabled.$description: Disabled text on dark surfaces. Signals an inactive element over midnight.

default.$description: Brand-emphasis text. Use for links, brand-coloured labels, and callouts.

subtle.$description: Lower-emphasis brand text. Use for hover states on brand links and secondary brand callouts.

muted.$description: Minimal-emphasis brand text. Use when brand presence is wanted but should not dominate.

strong.$description: High-emphasis brand text. Use for active or pressed brand states.

focus.$description: Focus state for brand-coloured text elements.

disabled.$description: Brand text in locked or disabled state. Drops to neutral grey since brand emphasis no longer applies.

default.$description: Primary positive text. Use for "Active", "Confirmed", "Paid", and other success states.

subtle.$description: Lower-emphasis positive text. Use for supporting success messaging.

disabled.$description: Positive text in disabled state. Drops to neutral grey when the positive meaning no longer applies.

default.$description: Primary error text. Use for failures, destructive labels, and critical alerts. Uses orange — red is reserved for brand.

subtle.$description: Lower-emphasis danger text. Use for supporting error context.

muted.$description: Minimal-emphasis danger accent. Softest error cue.

disabled.$description: Danger text in disabled state. Drops to neutral grey when the danger meaning no longer applies.

default.$description: Primary warning text. Use for "Pending", "Expiring", and "Action required" states.

subtle.$description: Lower-emphasis warning text. Use for supporting caution context.

muted.$description: Minimal-emphasis warning accent. Softest caution cue.

disabled.$description: Warning text in disabled state. Drops to neutral grey when the warning meaning no longer applies.

strong.$description: Interactive borders are independent values that are placed over the surfaces based purely on good enough visual contrast. Subtle is a universal border for light surfaces and emphasized elements

Accent/subtle is a universal border for secondary surfaces that have good enough contrast according to accessibility standards (mostly light ones but dark ones are also possible).

active-disabled.$description: Disabled active icon color on dark surfaces.

focus.$description: surface-color appears only on active (focus) state. This default focus color is supposed to be a default active surface for navbar-tab, which is brand-red.

focus-special.$description: surface-color appears only on active (focus) state. This special focus color is supposed to be a special active surface for navbar-tab, which is brand-red. Special use-case is a single specific dominant element across the tabs

default.$description: this is the default (idle) color for text and icons when the tab is not active. Inactive tabs don't have a specific surface color.

focus.$description: This default focus text color (for the page name and the icon) is supposed to be used on default active surface for navbar-tab, which is raised surface (white)

focus-special.$description: This special focus text color (for the page name and the icon) is supposed to be used on special active surface for navbar-tab, which is surface-brand (red)
